PM2 is a Node-native process manager with cluster mode, zero-downtime reloads, and log handling built in.

systemd is the Linux service manager already running on your server, language-agnostic and with no extra dependency. Pick PM2 for a pure Node app that wants clustering and easy reloads. Pick systemd when you want one supervisor for every service on the box.
